milestones.name: Read-only audit and evidence registry
milestones.remaining_scope: Historical inventory is not a full semantic or numeric re-audit of every experiment.

milestones.name: Extract readable core and reproduce archived outputs
milestones.acceptance: 421 causal state hashes, 1501 exact requests and all latest sweep point metrics match archived evidence.

milestones.name: Native backend parity
milestones.procedure: Run the old pinned backend and new adapter on the same small fixed set of archived requests, on the same GPU/runtime. Compare unrounded probabilities, mappings, encodings and decisions; include choice, NOUL, long contexts and repeated request ordering.
milestones.acceptance: Record numerical differences and justify any tolerance before scientific use. No silent changes to old results.

milestones.name: Verified graph and observable safety annotation
milestones.procedure: Produce scenario-group split and annotation guide; create 120 pilot trajectories; freeze blind packets; obtain two independent annotations and adjudicate. Check whether each gold claim is identifiable from the visible prefix.
milestones.acceptance: Hash-frozen inputs, labels, ambiguity ledger and scenario-group split; no predictions viewed during adjudication.

milestones.name: Verified graph mechanism pilot
milestones.acceptance: Freeze remaining choices on development, then read locked pilot once; compare correct structure against both full context and the same highlighted events without edges.

milestones.name: LINK quality and corruption sensitivity
milestones.procedure: Evaluate short neutral NOUL and simple identifier/previous-event baselines on graph gold; use macro trajectory AP, micro AP and structural errors. Freeze operating threshold on development. Compare controlled edge deletion/addition/rewiring at specified severity levels.

milestones.name: Independent end-to-end confirmation
milestones.procedure: Size a separate locked scenario-group-disjoint cohort using development variability and a prespecified useful effect. Freeze inferred-graph pipeline, baselines and statistics before inference.
milestones.acceptance: Benefit over full context and node-only highlighting, reported with clustered uncertainty, costs, coverage and model/domain limitations.

authorization: No new GPU experiments launched during repository extraction. Existing stopped experiments remain stopped.
unresolved_decisions: Minimum practically useful SAFETY AP gain
Confirmation cohort size after development power analysis
interpretation: The scientific goal is to locate a reproducible graph-specific benefit or identify the failing component, not to keep searching until a positive benchmark number appears.
